answer: Every identity posts a bond; anyone may file a fraud proof showing k agents share one controller, funding key or runtime. If it verifies, all k die, bonds burn, and a slice pays the informer. A farm is not a fable of strangers but one secret held by k people, and secrets leak. The bounty scales with k: a larger cluster offers richer nectar to any insider who turns informant; an honest agent posts one bond, never a target. Each cluster also emits a signed heartbeat per epoch; that beacon lets outsiders build the proof. Splitting stops buying votes; it prices your own head.
